title: Discrete series coefficients near 1, Laplace's method, and explicitly large Bessel functions
summary: Unit 133 (New/DiscreteSeries) supplies the archimedean lower bounds that Theorem B (enough forms) and the restriction periods of the exchange step need. Near the identity a discrete series coefficient ψ_l(g) of U(p, q) (Flensted-Jensen's function) is an explicit phase exp tr(diag(Λ(l)) lg(g − 1)) times a real factor κ ∈ [0, 1], with a uniform error (dsCoeff_gaussian_shape, from a second-order expansion of principal minors, MinorExpansion). For a 'two-factor' integrand θ(s) = ψ_l(j₁(s))·conj ψ_k(j₂(s))·e^{−φ(s)} on a group S (IsTwoFactor: steep weights, a purely imaginary additive phase, U(X) embedded diagonally) Laplace's method gives the explicit lower bound ν{‖j₁(s) − 1‖ ≤ 1} ≤ β^{20(|n|+|m|)²}·|∫θ dν| (IsTwoFactor.laplace_method). Two instances are built: the restriction r ↦ (r, ω⁻¹(r ⊕ 1)ω) with ω from Lagrange weights (IsSteep.exists_isTwoFactor_restriction), and the Bessel graph S = H𝖴 at a point x of controlled size (IsSteep.exists_isTwoFactor_besselPairHom); from the latter, Bessel functions with a peak at x are constructed (exists_isBesselFunction, HasPeakAt). The unit also proves the unfolding of the period of a deep-level Poincaré series against an automorphic form (norm_poincare_period_sub_le).

lemma exists_isBesselFunction {𝔰 I ε} [Fintype I] [Frame 𝔰 ε] {x v A b l u n} {rep :
  _ →* unitaryGroup I ℂ} (c : Continuous rep) (hc : ∀ k, ⟪v, (besselValueRep rep k).1 v⟫_ℂ =
  u.dsCoeff k) (hG : l.HasLargeGap A) (b0 : 16 ≤ b)
  (La : 𝔰.besselGraphMeasure.real {s | ‖(subOnePair (besselPairHom x) s).1‖ ≤ 1} ≤ b ^ n * ‖∫ s,
  l.laplaceIntegrand u (besselPairHom x) (fun s ↦ simpleRootSum s.1.1 - conj (simpleRootSum s.1.1))
  s ∂𝔰.besselGraphMeasure‖) : ∃ W, HasPeakAt l rep W x (b ^ (8 * 𝔰.r ^ 2 + 1 + n))
members.text: Let 𝔰 be a shape with a frame p for signs ε (Frame 𝔰 ε), r = 𝔰.r, I a finite type, rep : U(κ) → U(I) a group homomorphism into the unitary I × I matrices, continuous (c), v ∈ ℂ^I, u ∈ HCParam(1) a doubled Harish-Chandra parameter for the compact U(κ) with ⟨v, besselValueRep(rep)(k)·v⟩ = ψ_u(k) for every k ∈ U(κ) (hc), A ∈ ℕ, l ∈ HCParam(ε) of large gap A (hG), b ∈ ℝ with 16 ≤ b (b0), n ∈ ℕ and x ∈ G₁(𝔰). imports.name: HCParam
imports.lean: abbrev HCParam {n : Type*} (_ : n → ℤˣ) := n → ℤ

imports.name: HCParam.lowestKType
imports.lean:
def HCParam.lowestKType (l : HCParam ε) : HCParam ε := fun i ↦
  paramAddRho l i - twoRho l (ε · = ε ·) i
imports.text: Λ(l) = lowestKType(l): for l = 2λ, the weight Λ = λ + ρ − 2ρ_c, with ρ and ρ_c the half sums of all and of the compact roots positive for λ; explicitly Λ(l)_i = ⌊(l_i + 2ρ_i)/2⌋ − 2ρ_c,i with 2ρ_i = #{j : l_j < l_i} − #{j : l_i < l_j} and 2ρ_c,i the same count over j with ε_j = ε_i.

imports.name: HCParam.dsCoeff

def HCParam.dsCoeff (l : HCParam ε) (g : Matrix n n ℂ) :=

imports.text: ψ_l(g) = dsCoeff(l, g) = FJ_l(a_ε(g), a_ε(g)⁻¹g): Flensted-Jensen's normalised integral at the block-diagonal part a_ε(g) of g and a_ε(g)⁻¹g; on U(ε) it is the coefficient of the lowest K-type of the discrete series with parameter λ.

imports.name: HCParam.flenstedJensen
imports.text: FJ_l(g, z) = c_Λ⁻¹ ∫_K m_Λ(gk)·conj(m_Λ(k)) / m_{−μ}(kᴴzk) dk, with Λ = Λ(l), μ = λ + ρ = paramAddRho(l), K = K_ε the maximal compact subgroup with Haar measure of mass one, m_w = weightMinors(w, ·) and c_Λ = kTypeNormSq(Λ) = ∫_K |m_Λ|².
